Securities Processing, Daily NAV Validation, Cash & Position Reconciliations, Corporate Actions, and

stakeholders to deliver accurate, timely client servicing. Proficient in Investran, Bloomberg, DTCC, and

P R OF ES S I ON A L  EX P ER I EN CE 
STATE STREET | Hyderabad 
Senior Associate – Private Equity Fund Accounting Mar 2022 – Apr 2026 
• Managed end-to-end Fund Accounting activities for multiple Private Equity Master and Feeder 
Funds within a Markets & Securities Services and Global Custody environment.  
• Calculated, reviewed and validated Daily, Monthly, Quarterly and Annual NAV, ensuring 
accurate valuation, accounting, and financial reporting.  
• Managed the complete investment accounting lifecycle, including trade validation, accounting, 
settlement monitoring, reconciliation and NAV reporting, ensuring accurate books and records.  
• Supported Trade Capture validation by reviewing investment transactions, security master 
information, pricing, accounting entries and trade instructions before accounting and settlement.  
• Coordinated with custodians, fund administrators and global operations teams to monitor Trade 
Settlement, investigate settlement failures and resolve operational exceptions within SLA.  
• Performed Cash, Position, Securities, Bank and Investment Reconciliations, investigating breaks 
through root cause analysis and timely resolution.  
• Investigated trade exceptions, failed settlements, cash differences and reconciliation breaks while 
coordinating with internal operations, custodians and external stakeholders.  
• Supported Fund Administration activities including investor onboarding, capital calls, investor 
contributions, distributions, commitment tracking and investor servicing.  
• Processed investment accounting entries for purchases, sales, accruals, fair value adjustments, 
realized and unrealized gains and losses using Investran.  
• Supported the end-to-end product lifecycle for Private Equity and Fixed Income products, 
including trade validation, settlement monitoring, investment accounting, reconciliation, 
corporate actions, and NAV reporting.  
• Managed operational activities across the product lifecycle by coordinating with Fund 
Administration, Custody, and Operations teams to ensure accurate trade processing, settlement, 
valuation, and investor servicing. 
• Reviewed Corporate Actions impacting portfolio investments and ensured accurate accounting 
treatment and NAV adjustments.  
• Identified automation opportunities that improved operational efficiency and reduced manual 
errors. 
• Ensured compliance with operational controls, fund governing documents, accounting policies 
and internal risk management standards.  
BROADRIDGE FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS | Bangalore 
Process Analyst – Principal & Interest Oct 2019 – Feb 2022 
• Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting Markets & Securities Services for Fixed 
Income Securities. 
• Performed Trade Settlement activities for principal, coupon and maturity payments across Fixed 
Income securities. 
• Validated Trade Capture details, settlement instructions, security positions and payment 
eligibility using DTCC. 
• Processed securities settlements while ensuring compliance with settlement timelines, client 
instructions and operational procedures. 
• Investigated settlement breaks, payment exceptions and reconciliation differences through 
coordination with counterparties, custodians and internal teams. 
• Supported Corporate Actions including coupon payments, principal repayments and bond 
maturities. 
• Managed the trade lifecycle from Trade Capture validation, Settlement, Securities Processing, 
Reconciliation and exception resolution for Fixed Income securities. 
• Supported end-to-end Securities Operations including trade processing, settlements, 
reconciliations, corporate actions and custody operations. 
• Delivered Investment Banking Operations support across Fixed Income Securities including 
trade capture, settlement, securities processing and reconciliation. 
• Consistently achieved high quality standards while supporting operational risk controls and 
process efficiency initiatives.
